bio: A chic, modern and pleasingly neighbourly vibe makes itself felt in this restaurant in the attractive historical district of Striesen, which inspired the name of this place. Walls decorated with artwork by local artists, as well as the open kitchen draw the eye. In the evening, there is a choice of two set menus (omnivore and vegetarian/vegan) composed of three to six courses, or à la carte dishes. The menu changes regularly and takes its cue from the seasons. At lunchtime diners take their pick from a range of options on the Bistro Menu. Friendly and relaxed service....
